## Details

<a id="end_scene_ptrs"></a>
### [`end_scene_ptrs`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_cb84.asm#L6) `$CB84-$CB8B`

*data*

Pointers to the 4 figure records of the final stage of part 2: Drax stands, Drax throws, princess, princess variant. $8cc5 selects one with $cb. Nothing calls $8cc5 in part 1, so these records stay unused.

<a id="end_scene_0"></a>
### [`end_scene_0`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_cb84.asm#L9) `$CB8C-$CB97`

*data*

Sprite set-up, 12 bytes: animations of sprites 3-0, X positions of sprites 3-0, Y positions minus $a2.

- **Entry of:** [`end_scene_ptrs`](../../tables.md#end_scene_ptrs)

<a id="bolt_motions"></a>
### [`bolt_motions`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_cb84.asm#L19) `$CBBC-$CBBD`

*data*

Start motions $8a and $8b of the bolt (sprite 4) in the final stage of part 2. Part 1 has no final stage: no code reads them.

<a id="bolt_pass_move_ptrs"></a>
### [`bolt_pass_move_ptrs`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_cb84.asm#L22) `$CBBE-$CBC1`

*data*

Pointers to a list of 4 moves for each bolt motion. In part 2, one of these moves of fighter 0 stops the bolt. No code of part 1 reads them.
